unit: new randomly selected user -> current planner + one combined title embedding + initial 500-role retrieval
reviewer: Codex; independent human fit gold unavailable
gates: Exactly ten distinct eligible users, disjoint from all three users-v4 accounts; keep failed cases rather than replacing them
No planner, embedding or SQL errors/timeouts; preserve all first-attempt outcomes
At most 500 unique role IDs with title/company; missing posting URLs reported
All returned roles honor chosen countries/remote conditions, active external availability, company enablement, history exclusions, blocked companies and testOnly isolation
One comma-joined title input and one embedding vector; local languages appropriate to the search countries
Inspect each user's Profile/Brief, generated plan and top-ten role titles/descriptions for obvious unrelated job families or misread requirements; report uncertainty separately from hard violations
Empty or small lists require explanation; a nonempty list alone does not establish relevance
Preserve fixed salary weight 0.35 and existing country policy; no salary prediction persistence or scheduling change
Report first-attempt timings by context/planner/embedding/retrieval and API cost including failed attempts; separate any diagnostic costs/timing
knownLimits: Eligible sample requires existing Profile, Brief and Behavior and excludes previous three cases; not all registered users
Source roles are live and audit is a separate read
Only initial retrieval is evaluated; salary filling, full scoring/reranking, recommendation writes and messages are excluded
Manual top-ten inspection is not independent relevance gold or a review of every JD
A single run per user does not measure production p95 or long-term reliability

cases.direction: Senior strategic IT business partnership; Australian search with city preference. Do not equate hands-on developer roles with strategic business leadership.
Marketing background with broad exploration; remote preferred across named APAC countries. User compensation currency is unspecified; market estimate must not present it as stated currency.
Senior finance/FP&A or strategy/operations leadership in technology; Canada plus US remote only when working from Canada is supported. Company-size and city conditions need downstream evidence.
Experienced valuation/investment/M&A/corporate-finance work in Korea; no salary floor does not mean no market estimate.
Partner-equivalent venture investment responsibility; include Korea, flexible geography. Non-investment executive or junior investment work is weak.
Consulting-to-applied-AI business/product/process/solutions work in Korea. Explicitly excludes Engineer and Solutions Architect titles; self-study is not production engineering experience.
FDE/Java backend/software roles. Final opportunities require explicit Indonesia-remote permission or supported relocation/visa route; do not infer these from country/remote labels.
Korea-based technology country GM/Managing Director with P&L or business-growth ownership; ordinary manager/sales IC work is weak.
Finance-to-business-development/business-management/strategy at established companies. Korean-company overseas local hires excluded; overseas HQ assignments distinct.

Web publishing preferred, simple office work also acceptable; avoid treating the user as an experienced application developer. Korea commute preferences and low spoken-English ability require role evidence; part-time allowed.
